{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:')
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]['biomarker_baseline'].count())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_final
print('Sentinel values in biomarker_final:')
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999]['biomarker_final'].count())

# Check the distribution of 'arm' and 'responded'
print('\n--- Distribution of Arm ---')
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

print('\n--- Distribution of Responded ---')
print(trial_df['responded'].value_counts())

# Check for imbalance in baseline biomarker between arms
print('\n--- Baseline Biomarker by Arm ---')
print(trial_df.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline'].mean())

# Check for imbalance in severity between arms
print('\n--- Severity by Arm ---')
print(trial_df.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts())"}
